recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring a portrait of a man in a hat crouching in an urban setting, set against a soft salmon-pink gradient background. The layout includes a tracklist on the left and a stylized geometric emblem in the top-left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the right balancing the text block on the left
Soft-focus architectural background contrasting with sharp foreground typography
Warm salmon-pink wash unifying disparate photographic and graphic elements
Geometric emblem acting as a secondary visual anchor to the primary portrait
coreInvariants: Salmon-pink color wash across the left third of the frame
Subject in a low-angle, crouching pose wearing a fedora-style hat
Vertical tracklist aligned to the left margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is medium-scale, positioned in the lower right quadrant, looking upward and away from the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hat serve as the primary focal point, supported by the large display text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-right display text, moves down to the subject, then sweeps left across the tracklist to the top-left emblem.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper-left and center, filled with a soft pink gradient and blurred brick textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Salmon-pink gradient wash providing the overall mood and background base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and browns in the subject's clothing and the architectural shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for typography and multi-colored rainbow/blue accents within the top-left emblem.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted saturation in the background with high-value white text and high-contrast dark tones in the subject.

letterConstructionRules: Display text features ultra-thin strokes with double-line accents on specific characters
Body text is a clean, bold, all-caps sans-serif with slight drop shadows
Uniform stroke weight for the tracklist for maximum legibility
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'N' in the display name features a diagonal double-line motif
Vertical orientation for secondary name components
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Thin, stylized display type paired with heavy, functional body type for contrast.
graphicDevices: Framed emblem with rainbow and bird motifs

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric 80s feel of the display type
Matches the clean, functional look of the tracklist

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a black fedora and vest crouching in front of a blurred brick building. Apply a soft salmon-pink gradient overlay that is most intense on the left side. Leave the top-left corner open for a graphic emblem.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical tracklist in bold white sans-serif on the bottom left. Place a large, thin-weight geometric name at the top right. Add a rectangular emblem in the top left featuring a rainbow and symmetrical blue bird silhouettes.

verificationChecks: Is the salmon-pink gradient smooth and consistent?
Does the display text have the characteristic double-line 'N' motif?
Is the subject's pose low-angle and crouching?

adjustableVariables: Blur level of the architectural background
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and track titles
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for legibility of white text against the pink background
Ensure the subject does not overlap with the tracklist
Verify the geometric emblem is distinct and not muddy
Confirm the all-caps styling is maintained throughout
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-angle urban portrait with a heavy color-wash gradient, then overlay a high-contrast typographic grid using a mix of ultra-thin display and bold functional sans-serifs.
